顾承安没有跟着押送车去审讯点。

他站在江景商务酒店门口，目送陆鸣的车队拐过街角消失，转身拦了辆出租车，直奔会场。

该做的做了，该抓的抓了，但会议还在进行，他放心不下。

出租车在会议中心外围停下，顾承安下车，绕着整个场馆外围重新走了一圈。

没有动静就好。

布控点、通道口、地下车库入口，逐一走过，一个警示都没有冒出来。

他最后走到主会场大楼正门，透过玻璃门看了一眼里面，大厅里安保人员各就各位，与会专家们正在二楼报告厅听报告，一切秩序井然。

顾承安这才长长吐出一口气。

行了，安全。

他找了张大厅角落的休息椅坐下来，这时才感觉到饿。从昨晚到现在，就吃了俩包子，肚子都发出了抗议的声音。

旁边端坐的一名女性安保人员还扭头看了他一眼。

顾承安面不改色地掏出手机假装看消息。

这附近很难找到吃的，没办法只有再忍忍。

坐了大概半小时，他给陆鸣发了条消息：“审讯点地址发我，我待会儿过去一趟。”

陆鸣秒回了一个定位，附带一条语音：“你不休息一下？从凌晨折腾到现在。”

“不用。”

顾承安回完消息，又在会场待了一个多小时，确认上午场次的会议平稳结束，中午轮换安保团队也到位了，才起身离开。

审讯地点在浦东一片看起来很普通的居民区里，门牌上写着“星辉物业管理有限公司”。

国安魔都分局下设的秘密审讯站点之一，外表伪装成物业公司，里面的格局和配置就是另一回事了。

陆鸣已经在门口等着他了。

俩人一前一后走进一间类似办公室的房间，桌上摆着两盒没动过的盒饭。

“给你留的，吃吧。”

顾承安坐下打开一盒，红烧肉配米饭。他没客气，三口两口扒拉起来。

陆鸣靠着桌边，汇报进展：“朴正勋和佐藤光一已经交代了。”

刚说完，拍了下额头，以为顾承安不知道。解释了一遍：“就是那个保洁和厨师”

顾承安咽下一口饭：“这么快？”

“两人都是外围人员，拿钱干事的那种，没必要瞒着。

任务是找机会下毒，接触不到核心情报，问出来的东西基本上是执行层面的细节，往上的线索他们不知道。”

顾承安点点头，意料之中。

“记者、狙击手和那个女人呢？”

陆鸣摇头：“还没开口，尤其是许晴，一句话不说。”

“急什么，才半天，慢慢来。”

顾承安吃完饭，把盒饭盒摞在一起扔进垃圾桶。

“佐藤光一在哪间？我看看。”

Gu Chengan did not follow the escort car to the interrogation point.

He stood at the door of Jiangjing Business Hotel, watching Lu Ming's motorcade disappear around the corner, turned around, hailed a taxi, and headed straight to the venue.

What should be done was done, what should be caught was caught, but the meeting was still going on, and he was worried.

The taxi stopped outside the conference center. Gu Chengan got out of the car and walked around the entire venue again.

It's fine if there's no movement.

I walked through the control points, passageways, and underground garage entrances one by one, and not a single warning appeared.

He finally walked to the main entrance of the main venue building and took a look inside through the glass door. Security personnel were in place in the hall, and participating experts were listening to reports in the lecture hall on the second floor. Everything was in order.

Only then did Gu Chengan let out a long breath.

Okay, safe.

He found a chair in the corner of the hall and sat down, then he felt hungry.I have eaten two steamed buns since last night, and my stomach made a sound of protest.

A female security guard sitting next to him turned to look at him.

Gu Chengan took out his cell phone without changing his expression and pretended to read the message.

It's hard to find food around here, so I have no choice but to endure it.

After sitting for about half an hour, he sent a message to Lu Ming: "Send me the address of the interrogation point and I will go there later."

Lu Ming responded with a location in seconds, along with a voice message: "Why don't you take a break? You've been working hard since early in the morning until now."

"No need."

After Gu Chengan replied to the message, he stayed at the venue for more than an hour, making sure that the morning meeting ended smoothly and that the rotating security team was in place at noon, before he got up and left.

The interrogation took place in an ordinary-looking residential area in Pudong. The door sign read "Xinghui Property Management Co., Ltd."

One of the secret interrogation sites under the National Security Bureau in the Magic City, it is disguised as a property company on the outside, but the layout and configuration inside are another story.

Lu Ming was already waiting for him at the door.

The two of them walked into an office-like room one after the other. There were two boxes of untouched lunches on the table.

"Eat what's left for you."

Gu Chengan sat down and opened a box of braised pork with rice.He was not polite, and started to fight in two mouths.

Lu Ming leaned against the table and reported the progress: "Park Zhengxun and Sato Koichi have already explained."

Just after he finished speaking, he slapped his forehead, thinking that Gu Chengan didn't know.Explained again: "It's the cleaning and the chef."

Gu Chengan swallowed a mouthful of food: "So fast?"

“Both of them are peripheral personnel, the kind who get paid to do things, so there is no need to hide it.

The mission is to find opportunities to poison, and they have no access to core information. The things they ask are basically execution-level details, and they don't know the clues going up."

Gu Chengan nodded, as expected.

"Where are the reporter, the sniper and the woman?"

Lu Ming shook his head: "I haven't spoken yet, especially Xu Qing, who hasn't said a word."

"What's the rush? It's only half a day, take your time."

After Gu Chengan finished eating, he stacked the lunch boxes together and threw them into the trash can.

"Where is Sato Koichi? Let me see."
